abstract: Secondary prevention of rheumatic fever involves continuous administration of antibiotics to prevent group A streptococcal pharyngitis and recurrent acute rheumatic fever. Intramuscular benzathine penicillin G is administered as a single dose of 1,200,000 units (1.200.000 UI) for patients weighing >= 27 kg (> 30 kg) and 600,000 units (600.000 UI) for those weighing < 27 kg (< 30 kg). Intramuscular benzathine penicillin G every 3 to 4 weeks (every 21 to 28 days) remains the standard. For patients with acute rheumatic fever without carditis, secondary prophylaxis is recommended for 5 years after the last attack or until age 21 years (21 tuổi), whichever is longer. For patients with carditis but without residual heart disease, secondary prophylaxis is recommended for 10 years after the last attack or until age 21 years (21 tuổi). For patients with persistent valvular disease, secondary prophylaxis is recommended for 10 years after the last attack or until age 40 years (40 tuổi) or lifelong.
title: Secondary Prevention of Rheumatic Fever: A Scientific Statement From the American Heart Association
